name: manual_1a5268
claim: Never wrap backticked code spans inside double-quoted shell strings when posting coordination-board updates; backticks trigger command substitution and silently drop the enclosed text. Use single quotes, escaped backticks, or a here-doc instead.

decisions.notes: A coordination-board log lost literal command text because the sender used unescaped backticks inside a double-quoted shell string; the storage layer was fine, the bug was on the sender side.

rationale: A coordination-board log lost literal command text because the sender used unescaped backticks inside a double-quoted shell string; the storage layer was fine, the bug was on the sender side.
